description: Angular component for managing resource library in Thingsboard UI, including form handling, resource type changes, and notifications.

classes.name: ResourcesLibraryComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending EntityComponent for resource management, including form building, resource type handling, and user notifications.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets up resource type change observation if adding new resource.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: hideDelete
methods.description: Determines if delete option should be hidden based on table config.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Constructs form group for resource entity with validation.

methods.name: mediaTypeChange
methods.description: Updates mediaType descriptor when resource type is GENERAL.

methods.name: updateForm
methods.description: Patches form with resource entity data.

methods.name: updateFormState
methods.description: Enables/disables form controls based on current mode.

methods.name: prepareFormValue
methods.description: Prepares form data for submission, removing data if null during edit.

methods.name: getAllowedExtensions
methods.description: Returns allowed file extensions based on resource type.

methods.name: getAcceptType
methods.description: Returns MIME types accepted for resource upload.

methods.name: convertToBase64File
methods.description: Converts string data to Base64 format.

methods.name: onResourceIdCopied
methods.description: Dispatches notification when resource ID is copied.

methods.name: observeResourceTypeChange
methods.description: Sets up observable to handle resource type changes.

methods.name: onResourceTypeChange
methods.description: Handles logic when resource type changes, including form control updates.
